definition: Det Syntetiske Parti (English: The Synthetic Party) is a political party driven by artificial intelligence (AI), founded in May 2022 in Denmark.
details: The party aims to represent non-voters and fringe political parties while raising awareness of AI's societal role and exploring how it can be integrated into democratic processes.

explainer.lead: The Synthetic Party (Det Syntetiske Parti) is a Danish political party driven by artificial intelligence, founded in May 2022. It aims to represent non-voters and fringe parties while raising awareness of AI's role in society and democracy.

tiers.eli5: It is a political party whose ideas are shaped by a computer program, made partly to get people talking about how AI might fit into democracy.
tiers.practitioner: The project is a case study in applying AI to civic and democratic processes rather than a technical system. A pitfall in such work is that AI-driven representation can raise questions of accountability that the project itself is meant to explore.
tiers.paperLevel: An AI-driven political party founded in May 2022 in Denmark, with stated goals of representing non-voters and fringe parties and exploring AI's integration into democratic processes. No formal definition or metric is given.

explainer.example: Founded in Denmark in May 2022, the party frames its purpose as giving voice to voters and small parties usually left out of politics.
